ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to show nearby loads and repair shops on the map, share your position in chats or SOS, and show the route to the cargo owner during a trip.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: During an active trip your route is recorded and shown to the cargo owner and dispatcher, even when the app is closed or not in use. Recording stops when the trip is closed or when you stop it yourself.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: During an active trip your route is recorded and shown to the cargo owner and dispatcher, even when the app is closed or not in use. Recording stops when the trip is closed or when you stop it yourself.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take photos of documents, receipts, cargo and vehicles, and to scan documents. Scanned documents are sent to an AI service to read the text.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to choose photos of documents, receipts and listings from your library. Only the photos you pick are accessed.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used to record voice messages in chats and to describe a problem to a mechanic by voice. Recordings may be sent to an AI service to convert them to text.
